ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, A and B are located on the left and right sides and at the same horizontal height, each having a rope-winding device; two sections of rope respectively extend obliquely downward from A and B to connect to the smooth hook below, forming an approximately symmetrical V shape; the heavy object C is suspended below the hook. Then reason: The heavy object C descends slowly, so it can be considered to be in static equilibrium at every instant. Since the hook is smooth, the magnitudes of the tension in the same rope are equal. Let the tension in each section of rope be T, and let the angle between each section of rope and the vertical direction be θ. When the heavy object is in force equilibrium, the vertical components of the ropes on both sides together balance the weight, namely 2T cosθ = mg, so T = mg/(2cosθ). When C descends slowly, the V shape becomes deeper, the two sections of rope become closer to the vertical direction, θ gradually decreases, and cosθ gradually increases; therefore T gradually decreases.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出：A、B 是左右同一高度的绕绳装置，两段绳从 A、B 斜向下汇合到下方的光滑挂钩，挂钩下悬挂重物 C，整体呈对称的 V 形。再用题干信息：转动 A、B 使重物 C 缓慢下降，过程可视为每一瞬间静力平衡，且挂钩光滑，所以同一绳上的张力大小相同。设每段绳与竖直方向夹角为 θ，重物受力平衡时，两段绳张力的竖直分量支持重物：2T cosθ = mg。当 C 下降时，图中 V 形变得更“深”，绳段更接近竖直方向，θ 逐渐减小，cosθ 逐渐增大，因此 T = mg/(2cosθ) 逐渐减小。
